title: Fluted Panel — one Math Engine, four flute profiles, shadow gap and a TV cutout
description:
A parametric FLUTED PANEL on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SEGMENT. This is the plan's TV wall — a fluted run with a shadow gap at both ends and, optionally, a hole for the screen.

THREE OF THE FOUR PROFILES ARE THE SAME QUAD. A flute is a quad in plan swept up the wall: back edge on the backer, front edge at the flute depth. Square, Tapered and V-groove differ only in the front edge's half-width — `_frontR` is `_r`, `0.45·_r` or `0` — so they are one table with a different number in it, and V-groove collapsing to a point is a triangle the kernel already accepts.

HALF-ROUND IS THE SAME FLUTE SAMPLED. Each of `sides` slices spans an arc of the semicircle and is still one quad, so a faceted round flute takes the identical path as a square one rather than needing a lathe.

THE CUTOUT IS A SPLIT IN Z, NOT A SUBTRACTION. Flutes whose width overlaps the cutout are built as two bands, below it and above it. Flutes outside keep a full-height first band and a zero-height second one — one wasted row each, and in exchange the table keeps a single shape and there is no branch.

THE SHADOW GAP IS A REAL INSET. `_ru0 = _u0 + _sg` shortens the fluted run inside the panel, so the gap is a reveal rather than a flute that happens to be missing, and `runLength` reports what is actually fluted.

THE PITCH IS REDIVIDED, NOT TRUNCATED: `_pw = _run / round(_run / pitch)`, so the flutes always fill the run exactly and the requested pitch is a target. `actualPitch` reports what you got.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: 2.032 × 2.972 m, 2.008 m of fluted run, 39 half-round flutes at 0.0515 m actual pitch, 0.036 m total depth.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Flutes are vertical — a horizontal slat wall means hosting this on a segment turned on its side, which the object does not do for you. One cutout, rectangular, centred on the panel's length. The backer is a flat slab with no frame or battens.
